title: Mutations of Local Floer Chain Complexes across Hamiltonian Bifurcations
summary: We compute the chain-level change of local Floer complexes across the generic bifurcations of periodic orbits in four-dimensional Hamiltonian systems. Although local Floer homology is invariant across a bifurcation, the underlying chain complex mutates: periodic orbits and their Conley--Zehnder indices change discontinuously, and the Floer differential must change to compensate. Two tools make this mutation computable. First, we prove a Floer cascade counting theorem for Floer cylinders between multiply covered orbits of an autonomous system, which is not specific to the bifurcation analysis…
